Read .agents/skills/lighting-proof/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/lighting-library/SKILL.md. Fittings are real products from the verified luminaire library; their figures come from the manufacturer's LDT, never typed. Use the lighting engine and independent renderer rather than estimating illuminance in prose. Distinguish direct, reflected and occluded light; test like-for-like inputs. Return measured agreement, image findings and unverified assumptions. Confirm every source is the measured emitter of its fitting and that its photometric file describes that fitting; agreement between two consumers of the same input is not validation. Do not change geometry or targets merely to obtain a passing report.
